title: Tokens, foundations and the base, plain and eva themes
goal: Three token layers and three themes, test-first
acceptance: styles/tokens.css (primitive and component), styles/themes/{base,plain,eva}.css (semantic), foundations.css (focus, motion, type)
SEMANTIC_TOKENS, THEMES and applyTheme with unit tests; browser suite checks every theme defines every semantic token
eva matches NERV Eva · Dark · Orange; base and plain are neutral (NERV Simple light and dark)
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no consuming project's real data, secrets or tokens in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Done 2026-11-25 in the setup PR; verification is the PR's CI and a visual look at the catalogue.
